chunks: And put me among the inheritors of Paradise of Bliss.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be an inheritor of Paradise in Shia supplications?
ai.summary: This verse, recited frequently in Shia supplications such as those in Sahifa Sajjadiyya, highlights the eschatological reward for the faithful as an inherited legacy of divine grace rather than mere merit. It underscores the Shia theological emphasis on the continuity of spiritual inheritance through the Ahl al-Bayt, linking personal piety to the broader covenant of prophethood.
